verdict.detail: Discogs lists 3 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
First French pressing:
- Gatefold sleeve fully laminated outside and inside.
- Black BYG labels.
- Printed by

.

Side A ends in a locked groove.

Several track names and composing credits differ between the gatefold and labels.

The catalogue number "529 345" appears on the sleeve.
The catalogue number "529.345" appears on the labels.

Runouts are etched.

In the gatefold:

Robbins Music
This album was layed at Marquee Studios London in January-February 1971
Distribution Discodis
Imprimerie de Saint Michel - Made in France

On the labels:
Mono-Stereo
